messages:
tess: Opening a tiny migration PR focused on the essentials: update SDK calls, CLI smoke check, and one-note on embedding alias dims. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302
omar: can you paste the minimal py + go snippets here so i can sanity-check wording?
tess: python snippet (single-flow):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"$REDWOOD_KEY\")
resp = client.responses.create(model=\"redwood-v2\", input=\"Summarize: 1 line\")
print(resp.output_text)
```
elaine: go snippet LGTM but note: v2 renamed parameters, so call out old->new mapping in a bold note.
omar: added a single-line curl for CI smoke: `curl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"input\":\"ok\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses | jq -e '.output_text'`
tess: doc-bot found a stale link to /guides/embeds -> should be /guides/embeddings/migration. i fixed it in the branch.
elaine: small editorial: include an "upgrade checklist" with 4 bullets: update SDK, update calls, re-index embeddings if alias changed, run smoke test.
qa-bot: staging deploy scheduled after merge. Please ensure CI smoke step passes.
tess: assigning reviewers @omar @elaine. aiming to merge today if CI green. :rocket:
